The declaration is needed and not decorative: a member of a protocol is built only when its owner is a protocol row this registry carries, and without this row the two messages below are declared and never built. The two @optional members are the 26.2 header's own (MKLocalSearchCompleter.h:62-68) and the 16.4 header's own (:48-50), the same two selectors in the same order
entries.effect: the protocol an application's delegate conforms to for the port's own completer: it declares -completerDidUpdateResults: and -completer:didFailWithError: as OPTIONAL, both @optional in the SDK's own headers, so a conformer implements neither, one or both and the port's completer asks for each only where the delegate responds to it
entries.source: apple.objc.inventory on the armv7 dyld shared cache of 6.1.3, which finds 0 occurrences of MKLocalSearchCompleter and 0 of MKLocalSearchCompleterDelegate, so both are the port's own; the SDK 16.4's MapKit.framework/Headers/MKLocalSearchCompleter.h:48-50 and the SDK 26.2's :62-68, which agree on both members; and CharonMapKit.h:42, where this port declares it
